questions.question: 2027~2035년 Adobe의 senior-note maturity wall과 cutoff 이전 가용 유동성은 무엇인가?
trigger: FS criterion: liquidity/leverage and stress survival
User-uploaded normalized extract warns debt principal amounts were not extractable from its excerpts

evidence.claim: As of 2026-05-29 Adobe had $6.15B senior notes at par: $850M due Feb-2027, $500M Apr-2027, $800M Jan-2028, $750M Apr-2029, $700M Jan-2030, $1.30B Feb-2030, $750M Apr-2034, and $500M Jan-2035. Current senior-note principal was $1.35B.
As of 2026-05-29 Adobe had $500M commercial paper outstanding (carrying value $494M, weighted-average interest rate 3.76%) and no borrowings on its $1.5B revolving credit facility.
evidence.source_section: Liquidity and Capital Resources; Commercial Paper Program

questions.question: Adobe의 최근 자사주 매입 집행가격을 1차 자료에서 검증할 수 있는가?
trigger: Special question: whether aggressive repurchasing offsets dilution at current valuation

evidence.claim: Q2 FY2026 monthly repurchases were 2.9M shares at $260.24, 2.5M at $241.27, and 3.1M at $245.90; total 8.5M shares.
Share-weighting Adobe's three disclosed Q2 FY2026 monthly repurchase prices gives an estimated quarterly average repurchase price of about $249.43/share.
The user-provided normalized extract records settlement of Adobe's March 2025 ASR at 9.1M total shares and $383.14 average price per share.
evidence.source: ADBE uploaded normalized-facts extract; source document Adobe 10-Q filed 2025-06-25

remaining_unknowns: Exact average repurchase price for the 9.5M shares repurchased in Q3 FY2026; the 2026-09-10 earnings release discloses share count but not average price.
A single verified four-quarter weighted-average repurchase price using identical definitions for every quarter.
